title: UC1846 Current-Mode Push-Pull Converter (Open Loop)
description: Push-pull isolated converter driven by a behavioral UC1846 current-mode PWM controller model (open loop). Regulates the output near 5 V. Uses Alonso's corrected schematic revision.

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: push_pull_uc1846.qsch is Alonso's corrected ('- new') schematic; push_pull_uc1846.cir is the self-contained QUX netlist. UC1846.sub is Alonso's behavioral UC1846 controller model (from his UC1846.zip) and is referenced by the netlist via '.lib UC1846.sub'; it is bundled alongside. The netlist also references QSpice's bundled NMOS.txt/Diode.txt device models by their default install path.

workflows.title: UC1846 Current-Mode Push-Pull Converter -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files (including UC1846.sub) into the workspace and simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).
